conventions.hex: Values are copied verbatim from the minified CSS (lower-case, shortest form, 8-digit #rrggbbaa for alpha). flat_on_* values are opaque composites (straight alpha, sRGB) for video/print where there is no live backdrop.
conventions.themes: Theme sets are scoped to body[data-theme="natt"] (default; server HTML ships it) and body[data-theme="morgon"]. The choice persists in localStorage "tf-theme"; an inline script in <body> applies it before first paint.
conventions.reference_backgrounds_note: body = body background-color (3q17cp_jgfwol.pretty.css:606 / :610). backdrop_median = median pixel of the fixed .bg layer as rendered at 1440x900 (derived/color/backdrop-layer__<theme>__desktop.png). backdrop_copy_column = median of the same layer in the hero copy column (x188-700, y140-650).

coral.note: --coral is defined but never referenced via var(); coral appears only as raw 8-digit hex (#ff615424/#ff61541f chip fills in the theme sets, #ff61544d glass rim, #ff615466 ember rim).

starfield.css: six single radial-gradient dots (1-1.6px) at fixed % positions, 4.6s twinkle 0.95<->0.55 opacity

page_background.crossfade: body background-color and color transition 0.5s ease (--theme-transition-*); .bg-night/.bg-day swap by opacity over 0.5s.

page-ink.role: Primary text straight on the page backdrop: h1, h2, step h3, section headlines; also body `color`.

page-sub.role: Secondary text on the backdrop: hero lede, section intros/ledes, step copy, captions, CTA microcopy, map labels.

accent.role: Interactive accent: focus outlines, drop caps, links, active language pill, upload/friend hover borders, field focus border. Gold in natt, violet in morgon.

accent-ink.role: Accent used AS TEXT: the highlighted words in h1 (`h1 .grad`). Same as --accent in natt; a darker violet (#5b3fc7) in morgon for legibility.

card.role: Glass card fill (translucent, with backdrop blur): .glass, .badge, .book, memory tag, create-customize, cs-chip, figcaptions.

card-line.role: Hairline on glass cards; also footer rule, legal divider, create-customize section dividers, inline separators.

card-blur.role: Backdrop-filter blur radius for glass (not a colour, but it decides how the backdrop colours mix into the card).

card-sub.role: Secondary text on cards; also nav links, inactive language button, footer links/meta, form labels, placeholders.

frame.role: Thick passe-partout border around book covers, portraits and avatars (3-6px); hiw-frame fill. Deep navy in natt, white in morgon.

frame-line.role: Thin outer line of the portrait frame (.hiw-frame).

chip-bg.role: Neutral chip fill: kicker, sec-chip, voice chip, upload camera tile, family-switcher chip, field fallback fill.

chip-ink.role: Neutral chip text; also dashed "add" buttons and invite slot.

pill-bg.role: Violet category pill fill: book-sub, hiw-kicker, chip.violet, pressed sound bed, pressed friend-mode option; gradient partner in avatars.

micro-ink.role: Micro line under step copy (.hiw-micro). natt: --page-sub at 85% via color-mix.

h1-shadow.role: Soft dark glow under h1/cs-h1 for legibility over the nebula (none in morgon).

gold-chip-bg.role: Gold chip fill: chip.gold, step-number nodes, paint pill, map choice markers, success/status notes, avatar gradients.

gold-chip-ink.role: Gold chip text; star specks on story tiles; map numbers; initials in portrait placeholders.

coral-chip-bg.role: Coral chip fill; error alert background (auth, upgrade).

coral-chip-ink.role: Coral chip text; error text (field-error, alerts).

trait-line.role: Outline of unselected trait / pick toggles.

trait-ink.role: Text of unselected trait / pick toggles.

trait-on-bg.role: Fill of selected trait / pick toggles.

trait-on-line.role: Outline of selected toggles; hover outline for toggles, cs-chip, sheet close; active progress dot.

dash-line.role: Dashed lines: upload drop zone, add-friend, how-it-works rail, invite slot, map path.

choice-bg.role: Story-choice buttons and reader prompt; auth inputs; sound beds; sheet close; feedback textarea.

prose-ink.role: Story prose in the reader (Source Serif 4).

btn-grad.role: Primary button fill (135deg two-stop gradient); theme-toggle thumb; avatar FAB; play button; active job-step dots.

btn-ink.role: Text on --btn-grad and on --accent (active language pill).

btn-shadow.role: Coloured glow under primary buttons (gold glow in natt, violet glow in morgon).

ghost-bg.role: Ghost/secondary button fill, nav CTA, theme-toggle track, sound panel, friend-photo step, inline friend form.

ghost-ink.role: Ghost button text; theme-toggle option text.

control-line.role: Outline of controls (theme toggle, ghost buttons via --ghost-line).

card-shadow.role: Drop shadow of cards, books, covers (navy-black in natt; two-layer plum in morgon).

logo-ink.role: Wordmark colour (Cinzel caps); reader and ceremony titles; surprise door star; story-door register label.

logo-shadow.role: Wordmark glow: dark drop + gold halo (natt) / soft plum drop + violet halo (morgon).

map-dot.role: Dots on the how-it-works story map.

map-glow.role: Glow behind map medallions and the "next book" cover.

accent_swap.note: Gold leads at night, violet leads in the morning; gold survives in morgon only as status/marker colour (--gold dots, --gold-chip-*, map choice ring --gold-soft, create-customize chevron --gold-soft).

glod_stage.canvas_source: source/js/1pgfdvt65g9p-.js (createGlodScene). The object `l` holds natt/morgon; `a` is used when variant==="ambient" and theme==="morgon" (function x(e){return M&&"morgon"===e?a:l[e]}). `eT` are the four flame layers drawn back-to-front. Values copied verbatim; rgb triplets without rgba() are used inside template strings as rgba(${...},alpha).

illustration.style_prompt_verbatim: Warm watercolor and colored-pencil children's-book illustration style, soft light, rounded shapes, expressive small gestures. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no signage anywhere in the image.
